10266|3852bbda.name: Ug'thok
10266|3852bbda.text: Snarl calls me simple because I am too slow. I just want to do the job right, and that takes time.

11017|788cf9fc.name: Roxxik
11017|788cf9fc.text: Nice try, but you'll need some more experience before training with me! Back to the trenches!

11026|0161bb95.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|0161bb95.text: This kind of work isn't for the faint of heart. I have an uncle who lost a hand! Poor old Stumpy... anyway, if you're still interested I might be able to show you a few things.

11026|40d3ed3c.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|40d3ed3c.text: You need to start learning things that are beyond my expertise! Talk to Lilliam Sparkspindle in front of the tent there. He'll set you on the right course!

11026|766a64ec.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|766a64ec.text: Ah, what a beautiful day to blow something up!

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1383|69c5780d.name: Snarl
1383|69c5780d.text: If I prove myself to Saru he will have no choice but to let me fight for one of his daughters. Then we will see who is sneering.

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1430|b48f927f.name: Tomas
1430|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?
16227|c5ceacbe.title: Show me where I can fly.

1651|c2467ddc.name: Lee Brown
1651|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

1938|cd4928e4.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938|cd4928e4.text: The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a reckless fool.

1952|7327dd7a.name: High Executor Hadrec
1952|7327dd7a.text: Hello, $C.  If you're here, then you must know that Silverpine is saturated with our enemies.  To survive, the Forsaken must drive them back!

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

198|9c6df40b.name: Khelden Bremen
198|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

2215|dc484bb4.name: High Executor Darthalia
2215|dc484bb4.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2329|a28d29e1.name: Michelle Belle
2329|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

237|7ae4f953.name: Farmer Furlbrow
237|7ae4f953.text: Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

2388|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?
2388|4a0923b3.title: Tell me about dungeons I could explore.

2388|5c2c3d34.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|5c2c3d34.text: Frustrated by the Dalaran wizards' lack of progress against the $r during the Third War, the Archmage Arugal elected to summon the extra-dimensional worgen to bolster his side's diminishing ranks. The wolf-men slaughtered the Scourge, then quickly turned on the wizards themselves and laid siege to the keep of the noble, Baron Silverlaine. The fort quickly fell into shadow and ruin. Driven mad with guilt, Arugal adopted the worgen as his children and retreated to the newly dubbed 'Shadowfang Keep'.

2388|b8eefffb.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|b8eefffb.text: Shadowfang Keep is in southern Silverpine just north of Pyrewood Village.
2388|b8eefffb.title: Shadowfang Keep

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

2391|5dffcf15.name: Serge Hinott
2391|5dffcf15.text: Another interruption. How am I supposed to get any work done like this? Don't answer that; do I look as if I care what you have to say? Why don't you go bother Mr. High-And-Mighty instead?

2399|536469cb.name: Daryl Stack
2399|536469cb.text: The place is a bit drafty... but what do I care? I'm dead.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

241|2823b3ed.name: Remy "Two Times"
241|2823b3ed.text: Hey there, friend.  My name's Remy.  I'm from Redridge to the east, and came here looking for business, looking for business.  You got any...got any??

2456|105cd232.name: Newton Burnside
2456|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2456|2237a3b1.name: Newton Burnside
2456|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

247227|0371bf6f.name: Riley Peltskinner
247227|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

248197|cc5aee35.name: Gor'mak
248197|cc5aee35.text: You won't find better equipment anywhere else!

248415|bdfaa98c.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|bdfaa98c.text: I heard ol' Marshal McBride was sendin' ye' my way.

253|e8768bd6.name: William Pestle
253|e8768bd6.text: Aha!  Good day, good day, Master $C!  Come, sit down and have a drink.  You have an enterprising look in your eye, and I think you'll find speaking to me worth your time...

261|a2b799cb.name: Guard Thomas
261|a2b799cb.text: Hello, citizen.  You look like a man with a purpose - do you have business with the Stormwind Army?

268511|ee845bad.name: Manifest Clerk Philmor
268511|ee845bad.text: Harbor work is open to everyone, but your personal safety is your own responsibility.

278680|fe2e6e48.name: Gabbi Goodwhistle
278680|fe2e6e48.text: What can I do for ya?

2857|6139c96a.name: Thund
2857|6139c96a.text: Who says Orcs aren't smart? It takes a lot of brains to be an engineer!

2934|2cd97b51.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
2934|2cd97b51.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3143|004c594f.name: Gornek
3143|004c594f.text: The Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a $c worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.

3153|97f614be.name: Frang
3153|97f614be.text: I don't train your kind $c.  Find your own trainer before you anger me.

3296|66e82c80.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|66e82c80.text: Look for Nogg's Machine Shop in the Valley of Honor northeast of Red Canyon Mining.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3401|8830368a.name: Shenthul
3401|8830368a.text:
The Shattered Hand's influence dominates these lands. We are the veil which covers Kalimdor: The protectorates, the police, the judges, the jury, and ultimately, the executioners. We see all, we know all.

You have grown much in the time which you have spent in service of the Hand, $N. The time has come to send you into the field.

Are you prepared to undertake your next mission?

3402|6cb63392.name: Zando'zan
3402|6cb63392.text: Zando'zan of the Shattered Hand. How can Zando'zan help you? He can't! He won't!

3412|3ec49d32.name: Nogg
3412|3ec49d32.text: You have earned the privilege of training with a higher instructor. Go see my pal Roxxik there.

3442|6812c5a7.name: Sputtervalve
3442|6812c5a7.text:
Interesting, interesting... I know of a druid that lives atop the hill above the Wailing Caverns, $N. She might be able to tell you more about this shard you have found.

Now, I must get back to work!
3442|6812c5a7.title: Tell me about the Glowing Shard.

3442|c0ad1190.name: Sputtervalve
3442|c0ad1190.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3483|aa3c8600.name: Jahan Hawkwing
3483|aa3c8600.text: The Barrens, with its hot sun and hostile denizens, is the perfect place to test your strength and fortitude.

3489|68d65f37.name: Zargh
3489|68d65f37.text: Have a look at my meats, friend.  You won't want to go out into the Barrens without a good stock of provisions.
3489|68d65f37.title: Let me browse your goods.

3494|a323d91f.name: Tinkerwiz
3494|a323d91f.text: I got nothin' more to teach! Not for somebody who knows as much as you do, anyway! You Horde types need to talk to Nogg in Orgrimmar!

3537|f0d40663.name: Zixil
3537|f0d40663.title: I would like to buy from you.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.
3615|ddd7878b.title: I need a ride.

377|3df2cbb2.name: Priestess Josetta
377|3df2cbb2.text: Do not turn your back on the Light, $c, it may be the one thing that saves you some day.

3934|174473b0.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|174473b0.text: Recently, a night elf druid named Naralex discovered a network of underground caverns within the heart of the Barrens. Believing he could use the caverns' springs to restore lushness to the Barrens, the druid began siphoning the energies of the fabled Emerald Dream. His vision somehow became a nightmare, however, and soon the Wailing Caverns changed into a den of vicious, deadly predators. It is said that Naralex still resides somewhere inside the labyrinth, trapped beyond the edges of the Emerald Dream.

3934|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?
3934|4a0923b3.title: Tell me about dungeons I could explore.

3934|864c5566.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|864c5566.text: The Wailing Caverns has its entrance at the Lushwater Oasis southwest of Crossroads in the Barrens.
3934|864c5566.title: Wailing Caverns

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

483|ed056522.name: Elaine Trias
483|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

483|fe52f4ea.name: Elaine Trias
483|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

5482|8cd6b7fd.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|8cd6b7fd.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5493|e332eb6d.name: Arnold Leland
5493|e332eb6d.text: Ah, a fellow Fisherman. Are you perhaps in need of a little training? Maybe I can show you a thing or two?

5494|ed056522.name: Catherine Leland
5494|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

5494|fe52f4ea.name: Catherine Leland
5494|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5513|451d1c98.name: Gelman Stonehand
5513|451d1c98.text: I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.

5518|ed403611.name: Lilliam Sparkspindle
5518|ed403611.text: You can learn from me in time... but not yet! Why don't you start out by talking to Sprite Jumpsprocket to my right here. You can check in with me after you've gotten your feet wet!

5519|3d4f7092.name: Billibub Cogspinner
5519|3d4f7092.text: If you insert tab A into slot B then of course it's going to go BOOM! Here, let me show you what I have and then you can ask Lilliam about how to put it together so it doesn't blow up.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

5784|3fc6ad9d.name: Waldor
5784|3fc6ad9d.text: The caverns below us are a source of strange and wondrous hides, but you must take care if you venture into their depths, $N. Remember that your own skin is far more valuable.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6739|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?
6739|4a0923b3.title: Tell me about dungeons I could explore.

6739|5c2c3d34.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|5c2c3d34.text: Frustrated by the Dalaran wizards' lack of progress against the $r during the Third War, the Archmage Arugal elected to summon the extra-dimensional worgen to bolster his side's diminishing ranks. The wolf-men slaughtered the Scourge, then quickly turned on the wizards themselves and laid siege to the keep of the noble, Baron Silverlaine. The fort quickly fell into shadow and ruin. Driven mad with guilt, Arugal adopted the worgen as his children and retreated to the newly dubbed 'Shadowfang Keep'.
6739|5c2c3d34.title: Can you tell me more about this place?

6739|b8eefffb.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|b8eefffb.text: Shadowfang Keep is in southern Silverpine just north of Pyrewood Village.
6739|b8eefffb.title: Shadowfang Keep

6739|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6741|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?
6741|4a0923b3.title: Tell me about dungeons I could explore.

6741|5c2c3d34.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|5c2c3d34.text: Frustrated by the Dalaran wizards' lack of progress against the $r during the Third War, the Archmage Arugal elected to summon the extra-dimensional worgen to bolster his side's diminishing ranks. The wolf-men slaughtered the Scourge, then quickly turned on the wizards themselves and laid siege to the keep of the noble, Baron Silverlaine. The fort quickly fell into shadow and ruin. Driven mad with guilt, Arugal adopted the worgen as his children and retreated to the newly dubbed 'Shadowfang Keep'.
6741|5c2c3d34.title: Can you tell me more about this place?

6741|b8eefffb.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|b8eefffb.text: Shadowfang Keep is in southern Silverpine just north of Pyrewood Village.
6741|b8eefffb.title: Shadowfang Keep

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

7166|912c996a.name: Wrenix's Gizmotronic Apparatus
7166|912c996a.text: The machine comes alive at your touch.

7230|07466ffc.name: Shayis Steelfury
7230|07466ffc.text: Yes? I have a breastplate to finish so this had better be good.

7233|0c7ac5e1.name: Taskmaster Fizzule
7233|0c7ac5e1.text:
Something plagues this tower. I've fallen ill and the other Venture Co. employees that work near or in the tower have also become sick.

Just last week, two of our patrollers died, only to instantly come back to life as mindless drones!

The lifeforce is draining from my body. I can feel myself losing control. Urges taking over... Bad urges... *Fizzule slaps himself in the face* Not yet... Listen... Mine is a position of power. This position privies me to some sensitive information.

7953|24ed9d67.name: Xar'Ti
7953|24ed9d67.text: <The raptor bares its teeth at you.>

823|b02f6a36.name: Deputy Willem
823|b02f6a36.text: Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...

8496|944c29ff.name: Liv Rizzlefix
8496|944c29ff.text:
Hiya! This workshop isn't mine, no! But one day after I finish training I am going to be an inventor, just like my hero, Marvon Rivetseeker.

You've never heard of him? Well it just so happens that he left quite some time ago to study some ancient troll ruins he kept talking about. He left in a zeppelin... not quite sure about where exactly he went...

Tanarasin? Tenkeris? Taneranisany?

<Liv shakes her head.>

No, that's not it...

8738|f3c8f530.name: Vazario Linkgrease
8738|f3c8f530.text: Greetings!  If you are here to access goblin engineering schemata, please have your goblin engineer membership card ready for verification.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

917|df54d1a6.name: Keryn Sylvius
917|df54d1a6.text: Well, well... look what the cat brung in... and how can I help you, $c?

963|f9eae059.name: Deputy Rainer
963|f9eae059.text:
I can't believe the officials in Stormwind, sending the bulk of our army abroad... when our home front is under so much pressure!

With thieves coming from Westfall and gnolls encroaching from from the east and west, it's a wonder Stormwind itself isn't besieged.

109-accept.name: Guard Thomas
109-accept.text: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
109-accept.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

16-progress.name: Gerard Tiller
16-progress.text:
Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.

If you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.
16-progress.title: Give Gerard a Drink

79092-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79092-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79092-progress.title: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal

95507-progress.name: Vrang Wildgore
95507-progress.text: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>
95507-progress.title: Vrang's Game
